messages:
monica_support: :rotating_light: Support noticed increased 503s for customer acme-inc, started 2026-03-16 10:29 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts and billing spikes.
ben_sre: Seeing a spike in hosted-api 503s, correlation with upstream infer worker crashing. Crash reason: SIGILL in attention kernel + GPU OOM on a subset of GPU nodes.
sre-bot: Alert: hosted-api-p95-latency > 2s, 503 rate 8% over 5m. Affected instances: infer-worker-7a3, infer-worker-9d1.
alice_eng: Can you paste a sample stack/log? any core dumps?
monica_support: Pasting trimmed log: 
```
[2026-03-16T10:30:12Z] infer-runner[pid=4238] FATAL: signal 4 (SIGILL) at 0x7fabc123
CUDA error: out of memory while allocating 256MB
stack: runtime::attn_kernel+0x1a4
```
carol_prod: Noted. Early hypothesis: prefetch + large context + dyn-batching triggered an invalid kernel path. Repro with a 40k token context + toolcall causes oom.
ben_sre: Repro steps from my VM: 
1) Send batch of 8 requests with ctx ~30k tokens
2) Enable prefix-prefetch
3) Observe worker OOM within 10s
mike_support: Customer says they saw billing surge while repeatedly retrying — asking for credits.
alice_eng: Short-term mitigation: disable prefetch on hosted routing for Acme and reduce max_batch_size to 2. I'll open a canary rollback.
ben_sre: Can we apply a runtime guard: catch SIGILL and gracefully fallback to cpu-quantized variant? Also set GPU mem reserve to +512MB on at-risk pools.
carol_prod: We'll push a hotfix: guard the attention kernel check and add safe path. Patch branch: fix/attn-kernel-safepath, will test on staging.
alice_eng: Ops: I've applied routing change for acme-inc to fallback-model variant and disabled prefetch. 503s dropped to 0.8% in the last 10m.
monica_support: Customer update: timeouts reduced, asked for billing credit. Who owns customer CS reply?
mike_support: I'll draft credit note and add runbook steps. @alice_eng please upload core dump to /dumps/7067773333-acme.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy fix/attn-kernel-safepath to staging started.
carol_prod: I'll run targeted stress test: 10k token toolcall loops for 1 hour, will report memory behavior.
ben_sre: Next: collect GPU driver versions, nvml logs, and recent model swap timeline. Scheduling postmortem once fix is validated.
monica_support: Thanks team. I'll keep customer updated and log billing ticket. :thumbsup:
